spec.title: Locating fixture replacement
spec.instruction: Confirm that the workbench is safe and ready, and prepare the new fixture and fasteners. Detach the old fixture and remove it using both units. Install the new fixture using both units, then use a shared tool to lock both fastening points and check the positioning.
